architecture: quality-gated three modality tokens per word, 2-layer 8-head cross-modal Transformer, 2-layer temporal Transformer, hidden=128, dropout=0.2
loss: frequency weighted CE power=0.5, label_smoothing=0, quality-weighted SmoothL1 weight=0.45, distillation_weight=0.2
optimizer: AdamW lr=0.00015, weight_decay=1e-3, batch=64, clip=1, patience=7
sampling: video-group replacement sampler with inverse group-size power=0.2
augmentation: curriculum clean 0.65->0.4, contiguous 0.2->0.28, remainder scattered TAV gaps
selection: full valid clean + contiguous + scattered profile from the predeclared q2 score
data_policy: safe train/valid only; full test and attachment-3 labels are never loaded
